name: Smart inbox: only what needs you
author: wizard
description: Chats › Inbox holds only what can't go on without you: a needs-you that blocks, an approval, a failed run (with one line saying why) and answers you asked for. Everything else finishes in Sent, whoever started it: done, FYI and check-this asks, watches, schedules and helper results, a new chat's first message. Running chats are in Sent › Working. Unread alone never puts a chat in Inbox, and a chat is never in both.
